verdict.rationale: Recurly documents exporting reports across customer records, subscriptions, invoices, coupons, transactions, and revenue recognition (recurly-docs-23, recurly-docs-11/15), and community evidence confirms Recurly's gateway includes 'credit card portability' as a differentiator (recurly-comm-9), supporting the payment-method-out claim. However, there is no explicit documentation of exporting usage records specifically, no dedicated 'full account export/migration' workflow described, and payment-method portability rests only on a community forum comment rather than first-party docs. Missing for 10: explicit usage-record export documentation, first-party payment-method-portability docs, and a documented end-to-end migration/export tool.
